log_ingestion_flow_enforcement.title: Log Ingestion Flow Enforcement Mechanism
log_ingestion_flow_enforcement.description: Indicates the mechanism enforcing unidirectional data flow on log collection channels entering the security management zone.

siem_ingestion_endpoint_directly_reachab.title: SIEM Ingestion Endpoint Directly Reachable from Production Zone
siem_ingestion_endpoint_directly_reachab.description: Indicates whether production zone hosts can establish direct network connections to SIEM ingestion endpoints without traversing a dedicated log forwarder or proxy in a DMZ/intermediate segment.

log_payload_validation_enforced.title: Log Payload Validation Enforced at Ingestion
log_payload_validation_enforced.description: Indicates whether structured input validation or schema enforcement is applied to incoming log payloads before they are processed by SIEM components.

log_source_authentication_required.title: Log Source Authentication Required at Ingestion Endpoint
log_source_authentication_required.description: Indicates whether SIEM ingestion endpoints require cryptographic authentication from log sources before accepting log data.

credential_scope_enforcement.title: Credential Scope Enforcement
credential_scope_enforcement.description: Indicates whether service accounts and API keys used by the security layer are scoped with least-privilege permissions or are broadly scoped/shared across zones.

credentials_shared_across_zones.title: Credentials Shared Across Zone Boundaries
credentials_shared_across_zones.description: Whether the same service account credentials or API keys are reused across the security management zone and one or more adjacent/managed zones.

zone_boundary_egress_credential_controls.title: Zone Boundary Egress Credential Controls Enforced
zone_boundary_egress_credential_controls.description: Whether explicit controls are in place to prevent credentials originating in the security management zone from being usable outside their intended zone boundary.

credential_rotation_period_days.title: Credential Rotation Period (Days)
credential_rotation_period_days.description: The maximum number of days between mandatory rotation of service account credentials and API keys used by the security layer. A value of 0 means rotation is not enforced.

egress_destination_allowlist_configured.title: Egress Destination Allowlist Configured
egress_destination_allowlist_configured.description: Whether outbound traffic from the security zone is restricted to an explicit allowlist of approved destination IPs, FQDNs, or CIDR ranges.

egress_port_restriction_enforced.title: Egress Port Restriction Enforced
egress_port_restriction_enforced.description: Whether outbound connections from the security zone are restricted to specific, approved ports rather than allowing all ports.

egress_tls_inspection_enabled.title: Egress TLS Inspection Enabled
egress_tls_inspection_enabled.description: Whether outbound encrypted traffic from the security zone is subject to TLS inspection or a forward proxy, enabling detection of covert C2 channels or data exfiltration.

action_channel_zone_authorization_scoped.title: Action Channel Zone Authorization Scoped
action_channel_zone_authorization_scoped.description: Whether automated response action channels enforce per-destination-zone authorization, preventing the SIEM from executing privileged operations in zones beyond its defined scope.

alert_action_integrity_verification.title: Alert-Triggered Action Integrity Verification
alert_action_integrity_verification.description: Whether the SIEM validates the authenticity and integrity of alert data before executing automated response actions, guarding against forged or replayed alerts triggering privileged operations.

action_credential_isolation_model.title: Action Credential Isolation Model
action_credential_isolation_model.description: The isolation model used for credentials that the SIEM uses to execute automated response actions across zones.

internal_vlan_segmentation_enforced.title: Internal VLAN/Segment Isolation Enforced
internal_vlan_segmentation_enforced.description: Indicates whether distinct VLANs or network segments are enforced between SIEM sub-components within the security layer, preventing flat-network lateral movement.

inter_component_acl_policy.title: Inter-Component ACL Policy
inter_component_acl_policy.description: Describes the level of access control list enforcement between SIEM sub-components within the security layer boundary.

management_interface_isolated.title: Privileged Management Interface Network-Isolated
management_interface_isolated.description: Indicates whether the highest-privilege management interfaces are placed on a dedicated, separately controlled management VLAN not reachable directly from collector or data-plane segments.

security_zone_traffic_excluded_from_siem.title: Security Zone Traffic Excluded from SIEM
security_zone_traffic_excluded_from_siem.description: Indicates whether ingress and egress traffic originating from or destined to the security management zone is excluded from SIEM ingestion rules, filters, or collection scopes.

boundary_ingress_egress_alerts_configure.title: Boundary Ingress/Egress Alerts Configured for Security Zone
boundary_ingress_egress_alerts_configure.description: Indicates whether alerting rules exist in the SIEM or a compensating control to detect anomalous ingress or egress traffic at the security zone boundary, independent of SIEM self-logging.

api_endpoints_bypass_zone_gateway.title: API Endpoints Bypass Zone Gateway
api_endpoints_bypass_zone_gateway.description: Indicates whether third-party integration API endpoints are reachable without traversing the primary SIEM zone gateway, bypassing centralized ingress filtering.

integration_api_ingress_filtering_enforc.title: Integration API Ingress Filtering Enforced
integration_api_ingress_filtering_enforc.description: Indicates whether the same ingress filtering policies applied to the primary zone boundary are also applied to third-party integration API endpoints.

integration_credential_isolation_enforce.title: Integration Credential Isolation Enforced
integration_credential_isolation_enforce.description: Indicates whether API credentials used for third-party integrations are isolated so that compromise of an integration credential cannot be used to access the broader SIEM management plane.

boundary_rule_validation_enforced.title: Boundary Rule Validation Enforced Pre/Post Deployment
boundary_rule_validation_enforced.description: Whether the change management process mandates automated or manual validation of firewall and segmentation rules both before and after deployment windows affecting the security management zone.

transient_permissive_rules_detected.title: Transient Permissive Firewall Rules Detected
transient_permissive_rules_detected.description: Whether overly permissive or temporary firewall/segmentation rules are currently present on the security management zone boundary that were introduced or left over from a recent deployment window.

deployment_window_recency_hours.title: Hours Since Last Deployment Window
deployment_window_recency_hours.description: Number of hours elapsed since the most recent deployment or reconfiguration activity affecting the security management zone boundary.

post_deployment_boundary_audit_status.title: Post-Deployment Boundary Audit Status
post_deployment_boundary_audit_status.description: The outcome of the most recent post-deployment boundary audit for the security management zone.

oob_network_ingress_egress_filtering_enf.title: OOB Network Ingress/Egress Filtering Enforced
oob_network_ingress_egress_filtering_enf.description: Indicates whether the out-of-band management network has dedicated ingress and egress ACLs or firewall rules enforced independently from the primary security zone boundary controls.

oob_network_segmentation_consistency.title: OOB Network Segmentation Consistency
oob_network_segmentation_consistency.description: Describes whether OOB management network segmentation controls are consistently applied, partially applied, or absent relative to the primary security zone.

oob_lateral_movement_paths_identified.title: OOB Lateral Movement Paths Identified
oob_lateral_movement_paths_identified.description: Indicates whether network path analysis or penetration testing has identified reachable routes from monitored production networks into the OOB management network without traversing an enforced security control.
